# Research report template

## Identity and scope

Role label; real session ID or unavailable; Work Order ID/revision; repository and exact commit; permitted output scope; date; intended decision. Omit private machine paths and sensitive identifiers from the public version.

## Question and completion criterion

State the question being answered and what evidence would make this assignment complete.

## Findings

| Claim | Classification | Evidence | Limitation or contrary evidence |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Fill in | Observed / source-supported / inferred / proposed / untested | Command output or primary source with checked date and revision | Fill in |

## Experiments actually performed

List commands/probes, expected observations, actual observations, and reproducible evidence locations. Mark unavailable tests. Keep raw logs local; publish only sanitized excerpts needed to support the claim.

## Recommendation and trade-off

Give one recommendation, credible alternatives, what would reverse it, and the smallest next experiment. Separate changing the goal from repairing a method.

## Resources and unresolved limits

Elapsed time, available model-usage telemetry, unknown cost, dependencies or access not available. State whether anything is still running. A missing measurement is unknown, not zero.

## Handoff

Fixed Submission identity, self-tests, known defects, proposed next Work Order, and independent-review needs. Stop here; proposing follow-up work does not claim or launch it.
